study type: Prospective cohort study with retrospective comparison group
exposure: Grade of myometrial invasion (simple praevia, accreta, increta, percreta)
cohort: 195 women diagnosed with placenta praevia (95 treated with parallel compression suture and 100 managed without the technique)
finding: The parallel vertical compression suture technique was effective in preserving the uterus in cases of simple placenta praevia and accreta, with high success rates of 98.33% and 88.23% respectively.
